LanguageData.FB_FleshParasite.label: flesh parasite
LanguageData.FB_FleshParasite.description: A fleshbeast larva planted by a stingmite's sting. It does not harm the tissue, but it slowly matures and spreads into neighbouring body parts. Once mature, it tears its body part off and crawls out; a large enough part releases a fingerspike loyal to the colony. It can be removed surgically, and a graftmaw can cut the infected parts out cleanly.
